a190_boundary_reported_first.classification_rule: an identity is RECORD-MINTED when a record creates it from an ad-hoc payload (its recipe must be co-located, A154) and CODE-PRODUCED when committed code produces it and records merely cite it (its recipe is co-located with the producer). The first pass conflated them and reported 1,441 records 'without a co-located recipe' — almost all of them frame records citing engine identities and records citing the protocol identity. That count was an artifact of the classification, not a finding
